Esperanto

laboratorio
Wikipedia eo

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /laboratoˈrio/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -io
  • Syllabification: la‧bo‧ra‧to‧ri‧o

Noun

[edit]

laboratorio (accusative singular laboratorion, plural laboratorioj, accusative plural laboratoriojn)

  1. laboratory
    Synonym: esplorejo

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Medieval Latin labōrātōrium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈlɑborɑtorio/, [ˈlɑ̝bo̞ˌrɑ̝t̪o̞ˌrio̞]
  • Rhymes: -io
  • Syllabification(key): la‧bo‧ra‧to‧ri‧o
  • Hyphenation(key): la‧bo‧ra‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

laboratorio

  1. a laboratory
    Synonym: labra

  • Hyphenation: la‧bo‧ra‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

laboratorio m (plural laboratorios)

  1. laboratory

Ido

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Esperanto laboratorio, English laboratory, French laboratoire, German Laboratorium, Italian laboratorio, Russian лаборато́рия (laboratórija), Spanish laboratorio.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /la.bo.raˈto.ri.o/, /la.bo.raˈto.rjo/

Noun

[edit]

laboratorio (plural laboratorii)

  1. laboratory

Interlingua

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

laboratorio (plural laboratorios)

  1. laboratory

Italian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • lavoratoio (inherited, archaic)
  • lavoratorio (rare)

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin labōrātōrium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /la.bo.raˈtɔ.rjo/
  • Rhymes: -ɔrjo
  • Hyphenation: la‧bo‧ra‧tò‧rio

Noun

[edit]

laboratorio m (plural laboratori)

  1. laboratory, lab
  2. workshop, workroom
  3. (education) workshop activity
    fare laboratorio ― engage in workshop activity

Related terms

[edit]
  • laboratorista
  • lavorare

Further reading

[edit]
  • laboratorio in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

labōrātōriō

Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
laboratorio
Wikipedia es

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin labōrātōrium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /laboɾaˈtoɾjo/ [la.β̞o.ɾaˈt̪o.ɾjo]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -oɾjo
  • Syllabification: la‧bo‧ra‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

laboratorio m (plural laboratorios)

  1. laboratory
    • 2022 June 3, Sandee LaMotte, “El efecto 'Benjamin Button': científicos logran revertir el envejecimiento en ratones. El objetivo es hacer lo mismo con los humanos”, in CNN en Español‎[2]:
      En el laboratorio del biólogo molecular David Sinclair en la Escuela de Medicina de Harvard, los ratones viejos están volviéndose jóvenes nuevamente.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)

  • laboratorista
